$comment: Policy for scripts/agent-doctor.mjs. Kept here, not in the script and not in prose, so
every change to it is a visible one-line diff and no document has to restate a version.
`minimum` is a floor, not a mirror of what is installed. Raise it only when the project
actually needs something a newer build provides; a client shipping a patch release is not
a reason to edit this file. The doctor reports the installed build and compares it here,
so docs/development/agent-clients.md carries no version numbers at all.
`prerelease` says what to do when the installed build carries a -alpha/-beta/-rc suffix:
allow — the operator tracks that channel deliberately; report it, do not warn
warn  — a prerelease is not the intended target for this project
